basis.governing_question: How does Banco Atlântico get its new branch operating model running in all 120 branches by week 24?

phases.name: Implementation
phases.objective_one_line: Roll out the new branch operating model to all 120 branches, with staff training and performance tracking running alongside.

gate.label: Final readout
gate.decision: Do all 120 branches run the new model, and is the rollout accepted as complete?

workstreams.name: Branch rollout
workstreams.answers: In what order do the 120 branches move onto the new branch operating model, and when is each live?
activities: Agree wave sequence and readiness checks for each branch
Launch the model wave by wave after the readiness review
Collect issues from branch staff and managers at each wave

workstreams.name: Staff training
workstreams.answers: How do branch staff get ready to work in the new model before their branch goes live?
activities: Prepare training content for each role in the new model
Train branch staff in each wave ahead of go-live
Coach staff after go-live using feedback from branch teams

workstreams.name: Performance tracking
workstreams.answers: Which measures show a branch is running the new model, and how do branches perform as each goes live?
activities: Define the measures that show a branch runs the new model
Track each wave on those measures using operational data
Check in branches that work follows the new model

deliverables.name: Wave sequence and readiness checks for 120 branches
Final go-live record and rollout acceptance pack
Role-based training materials for the new model
Training attendance and post-go-live coaching record
Branch performance measures for the new model
Performance tracking report for all 120 branches

events.label: Kick-off
events.decision: Confirm scope, team and calendar for the 24-week rollout?
agenda: Present the rollout objective and the 120-branch scope
Confirm the team roles and the meeting calendar
Align on the week-24 target: all 120 branches running the new model

events.label: Workshop 1: readiness
events.decision: Approve the first wave to go live based on the readiness checks?
agenda: Present wave sequence and readiness checks for the 120 branches
Review role-based training materials and branch performance measures
Decide on first-wave go-live based on the readiness checks

events.label: Check-in: first wave live
events.purpose: Check first-wave results and next waves
events.decision: Confirm first-wave go-live results so the next waves can proceed?
agenda: Present the first-wave go-live record by branch
Discuss issues found in the first wave and their effect on the next waves
Confirm first-wave results before the next waves proceed

events.label: Workshop 2: wave progress
events.decision: Confirm any wave adjustments needed for all 120 branches to be live by week 24?
agenda: Review the first-wave go-live record and the interim performance by wave
Discuss progress toward all 120 branches and the remaining waves
Confirm wave adjustments and the evidence the final readout will need

events.label: Final readout
events.decision: Do all 120 branches run the new model, and is the rollout accepted as complete?
agenda: Present the final go-live record and rollout acceptance pack
Review training attendance, coaching and performance for all 120 branches
Decide whether the rollout is accepted as complete

architect_notes: No Change & Training or Measurement phase: the brief names one 24-week rollout phase, so training and tracking run as workstreams inside Implementation.
Archetype departure: Diagnostic and Design from operating_model_redesign are dropped because the brief says the model is already designed; Implementation is added.
